caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic tumbler, rendered in shades of silver and gray, standing upright on a neutral beige background. The tumbler is cylindrically shaped with a slightly flared lip at the top and a reinforced, rounded base at the bottom. Light reflections and subtle highlights are visible along the sides and interior rim of the tumbler, suggesting a shiny, reflective surface typical of metal objects. The drawing is centered on the page, surrounded by ample blank space. Below the illustration, there is handwritten text in red ink providing details about the object, stating: "TUMBLER-SILVER 1785-1858 NO. 18709.27 BKLYN. MUSEUM, N.Y." on the lower left, and "MICHAEL TREKUR DEC. 9-1935 N.Y. CITY" on the lower right. The overall paper is off-white with some minor discoloration or spotting around the edges.
title: Tumbler
